references.authors: Martínez-García E, Calles B, Arévalo-Rodríguez M, de Lorenzo V
references.title: pBAM1: an all-synthetic genetic tool for analysis and construction of complex bacterial phenotypes.

provenance.sequence_source: HQ908071 (cloning vector pBAM1; Martinez-Garcia et al. 2011) 3259..3364, identical over 106 bp, directly upstream of and on the same strand as neo (Tn903 aph, CDS 3365..4180); the oldest of 45 exact deposits. Bases 6-106 are Tn903 (V00359 1061..1161, ending before the aph start codon at 1162); bases 1-5 are vector. The part was stored reverse-complemented until 2026-11 and now reads toward the gene it drives.
